description: This file contains the implementation of the CustomerAttributeService interface, providing methods to manage customer attributes such as saving, updating, deleting, and retrieving customer attributes by various criteria within the SalesManager e-commerce system.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for managing CustomerAttribute entities, extending generic entity service and implementing specific business logic for customer attribute operations.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerAttribute or updates an existing one based on its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a CustomerAttribute after retrieving it by its ID to avoid detached instance errors.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute by store, customer, and option ID.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves all CustomerAttributes for a specific customer within a store.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerAttributes based on option value ID within a store.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerAttributes based on option ID within a store.
